task: Implement the RFC 8878 frame and block controller in the assigned isolated worktree. Own only src/zstd_frame.c and updates required in src/zstd_internal.h. Parse normal/skippable/concatenated frames, headers, raw/RLE blocks, checksum and dispatch compressed blocks through the frozen context. Do not edit Makefile, public API/harness, tests, samples, RFC, or any entropy/sequence file. Commit your work and write RESULT.json through the native harness.
acceptance_criteria: The assigned fragment compiles when included by the root integration source.
Frame control rejects malformed bounded input and supports raw/RLE/skippable concatenation.
deliverables: Any necessary compatible additions to src/zstd_internal.h
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: The frame controller is an independent, mergeable prerequisite for integrated RFC decoding.
